title: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy
raw_excerpt: Nvidia has announced that it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company . A statement posted by the board of directors reads: The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramou … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 英伟达董事会宣布启动独立调查，核查 CEO 黄仁勋与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系。据报后者被中国国家安全部招募，用于刺探英伟达情报。董事会称将优先保障美国国家安全，由独立董事委员会与外部律师主导。此事直接牵动全球市值最高芯片公司的治理与出口合规，是本周 AI 硬件圈最大的不确定性来源。

title: OpenAI raises $11B at a $1.25T valuation
summary: OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元新融资，估值达 1.25 万亿美元，低于此前寻求的 1.4 万亿。在“AI 泡沫”争论升温、算力资本开支高企的背景下，这轮融资的规模与折价都具有指标意义：既确认头部实验室仍能吸金，也显示投资人对超高估值开始压价。后续资金投向与算力承诺值得跟踪。

title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
summary: 据 The State of AI 报道，高盛正撤下交易员与银行家使用的 Claude Code。这是大型金融机构对编码智能体的一次显著回撤，可能涉及合规、数据边界或实际产出未达预期。作为华尔街 AI 落地的风向标，此举会直接影响其他投行对第三方编码 Agent 的采购决策，也值得与 Anthropic 近期的企业叙事对照阅读。

title: Anthropic strikes $3.4B deal to generate gas-fired power for data centres
summary: 据 FT 报道，Anthropic 达成 34 亿美元协议，为数据中心专门建设燃气发电设施。这是 AI 公司从“买算力”走向“自建电力”的标志性一步，反映电网接入瓶颈已成为模型训练扩张的硬约束。该交易也将 AI 基础设施的碳排放与能源政策争议推到台前，与近期关于数据中心用电的公共讨论直接相关。

title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
raw_excerpt: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI czar Craig Federighi to accelerate the Siri roadmap and deliver a powerful AI agent that can compete with OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse. While Federighi has delivered a functional version of Siri AI on an incredibly short timeline, the company has no illusions that it's keeping pace with its rivals. Two significant improvements are expected to be made to Siri in the coming months. One will give the assistant fine-grained control over Apple's first-party apps, allowing it to do things like rotate and crop images in Photos and organize Safari tabs. Those capabilities are expected to … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 彭博 Mark Gurman 称，苹果 CEO John Ternus 正施压 AI 负责人 Craig Federighi 加速 Siri 路线图，目标是做出能与 OpenAI Dots、Meta Muse 竞争的强智能体。近期两项改进包括对自家 App 的细粒度控制（如照片旋转裁剪、日程整理）。这说明苹果承认在 Agent 竞赛中落后，Siri 正从语音助手转向可执行任务的系统级入口。

title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
raw_excerpt: Suno is facing yet another pair of lawsuits . A group of rights holders of Elvis Presley's music and the publisher of some of Eminem's biggest records are suing the AI music company, claiming it illegally generates music and lyrics that mimic those artists. The lawyers in the Presley suit claim that Suno has violated Tennessee's Ensuring Likeness Voice and Image Security (ELVIS) Act, which makes it illegal for an AI company to clone a singer's voice. In the suit, lawyers representing Presley's rights holders argue that "Suno has mechanically encoded itself with artists' identities, hard-work, creativity, and time, and harnessed them all for  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 猫王 Elvis Presley 音乐版权方与 Eminem 部分热门唱片出版商分别起诉 Suno，指其非法生成模仿该艺人的音乐与歌词。猫王一方援引田纳西州 ELVIS 法案，该法禁止 AI 克隆歌手声音。这是 AI 音乐领域最新一轮版权诉讼，将检验“声音人格权”立法在生成式音乐上的实际效力，对 Suno 及同类产品的训练数据与输出策略构成直接压力。

title: 资本正在撤离“世界模型”
summary: 量子位文章指出，资本正在撤离“世界模型”赛道。文章认为该方向在演示效果与商业回报之间长期错位，融资热度明显降温。对判断具身智能与视频生成的技术路线选择有参考价值：当资金退潮，团队将被迫在数据规模、仿真精度与落地场景上做取舍，而非继续堆参数讲故事。

title: Llama-modchip: 284B DeepSeek on 64GB RAM, no GPU
summary: 开源项目 llama-modchip 展示了在 64GB 内存、无 GPU 的机器上运行 284B 参数 DeepSeek 模型的方法，登上 Hacker News 热榜。其核心是通过内存与量化层面的改造，让超大 MoE 模型在消费级硬件上可跑。这对本地部署、隐私敏感场景和推理成本优化都有实际意义，也为“大模型必须依赖 GPU 集群”的假设提供了反例。

title: anthropics/skills
summary: Anthropic 在 GitHub 开源 Agent Skills 公共仓库，单日获约 792 星。该仓库提供可复用的技能定义，让 Claude 等智能体以模块化方式扩展能力，而非每次重写提示与工具链。对正在构建 Agent 产品的团队而言，这是官方给出的技能组织范式，可能推动跨平台的技能格式标准化。

title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
summary: HuggingFace 日榜高赞论文提出从“自主智能体”走向“认知共生体”，主张 AI 不应替代人类决策，而应增强人类智能。文章给出人机协同的概念框架与设计原则，讨论能力边界、信任与认知负荷。在 Agent 自主性争议升温之际，这篇立场鲜明的论文为“增强而非替代”的产品路线提供了理论支撑。
